  • Method Details

    • getValue

      int getValue(int row, int column)
      Gets the current value of a cell in a sudoku grid.

      Coordinates are indexed from (0, 0), which is the upper left-most cell in the grid.

      Parameters:
      row - The row, or x-coordinate, of the cell
      column - The column, or y-coordinate, of the cell
      Returns:
      The value currently stored at the cell, or -1 if the cell is empty.

    • setValue

      void setValue(int row, int column, int value)
      Sets the value of a cell in a sudoku grid.

      Coordinates are indexed from (0, 0), which is the upper left-most cell in the grid.

      Note that 1 <= value <= 9, or to set the cell as empty, value = -1

      Parameters:
      row - The row, or x-coordinate, of the cell
      column - The column, or y-coordinate, of the cell
      value - The value of the cell

    • isValid

      boolean isValid()
      Determines whether or not the current state of the sudoku grid is a valid solution so far.
      Returns:
      true if the grid is valid; false if there are any incompatible cells.

    • isSolved

      boolean isSolved()
      Determines whether or not the sudoku grid has yet been solved.
      Returns:
      true if the grid has been solved; false if there are any incompatible or empty cells.

    • resetGrid

      IGridState resetGrid()
      Empties the sudoku grid of values, updates the stored grid, and returns a copy of it.
      Returns:
      the emptied grid.

    • displayGrid

      void displayGrid()
      Outputs the current state of the sudoku grid.

    • getGridSize

      int[] getGridSize()
      Gets the size of the grid in terms of the number of sudoku squares it contains
      Returns:
      a list of two integers, representing the number of rows, and the number of columns in the grid respectively.

    • getGrid

      IGridState getGrid()
      Returns a copy of the current state of the sudoku grid.

      the current state of the grid.
